# M0-S2: alias extensions build and run; duplicate stems fail; dotted module warns.
env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

mkdir $WORK/bin

# Each alias extension builds and runs.
logos build -o $WORK/bin/scroll$GOEXE ./scroll
stderr -count=1 'portability::alias_extension'
exists $WORK/bin/scroll$GOEXE

logos run ./scroll
stdout '^scroll ok$'
stderr -count=1 'portability::alias_extension'

logos build -o $WORK/bin/lightning$GOEXE ./lightning
stderr -count=1 'portability::alias_extension'
exists $WORK/bin/lightning$GOEXE

logos run ./lightning
stdout '^lightning ok$'
stderr -count=1 'portability::alias_extension'

logos build -o $WORK/bin/gopher$GOEXE ./gopher
stderr -count=1 'portability::alias_extension'
exists $WORK/bin/gopher$GOEXE

logos run ./gopher
stdout '^gopher ok$'
stderr -count=1 'portability::alias_extension'

# Trailing U+FE0F is stripped before matching.
logos build -o $WORK/bin/vs$GOEXE ./vs
stderr -count=1 'portability::alias_extension'
exists $WORK/bin/vs$GOEXE

logos run ./vs
stdout '^vs ok$'
stderr -count=1 'portability::alias_extension'

# Two alias files in one package warn once per file, not once per package.
logos build -o $WORK/bin/multi$GOEXE ./multi
stderr -count=2 'portability::alias_extension'
exists $WORK/bin/multi$GOEXE

logos run ./multi
stdout '^multi ok$'
stderr -count=2 'portability::alias_extension'

# Single scroll file builds, so the duplicate below is not vacuous.
logos build ./dupok
stderr -count=1 'portability::alias_extension'

# x.lgo beside the scroll alias with stem x fails.
! logos build ./dup
stderr 'correctness::duplicate_stem_filename'

-- go.mod --
module example.com/m

go 1.27

-- scroll/main.📜 --
package main

import "fmt"

func main() {
	fmt.Println("scroll ok")
}

-- lightning/main.⚡ --
package main

import "fmt"

func main() {
	fmt.Println("lightning ok")
}

-- gopher/main.ʕ◔ϖ◔ʔ --
package main

import "fmt"

func main() {
	fmt.Println("gopher ok")
}

-- vs/main.⚡️ --
package main

import "fmt"

func main() {
	fmt.Println("vs ok")
}

-- multi/a.📜 --
package main

func greeting() string { return "multi ok" }

-- multi/b.⚡ --
package main

import "fmt"

func main() { fmt.Println(greeting()) }

-- dupok/x.📜 --
package dupok

func X() int { return 1 }

-- dup/x.📜 --
package dup

func X() int { return 1 }

-- dup/x.lgo --
package dup

func Y() int { return 2 }
